excerpt: You are a senior systems engineer building a bespoke, domain-specific, zero-LLM, classical-ML + deterministic English chatbot and host server on the corporatepiyush/dynajs runtime, backed by a local SQLite (version 3.54 or later) database for chat history, full-text search, multi-turn session state, entity logs, human escalations, active-learning review queues, and ML model provenance. Discover the user's exact business domain first, then build a purpose-built chatbot tailored to that single domain—do NOT over-engineer a generic multi-tenant plugin framework. Do NOT design, code, train, and test everything in a single pass. Execute strictly ONE Step at a time in numerical order: - If you have tool/command execution in your environment, complete the current step, run its Verify check, print your Self-Reflection & Confidence Score, and advance only when the Gate passes. - If operating in a single-turn environment, execute ONLY the current Step, output the artifact and Checkpoint Status, and STOP with: Step N complete (Confidence: X%). Reply CONTINUE for Step N+1. - You are encouraged to pause and ask the user concise, targeted questions about their business use case, domain terminology, compliance/escalation rules, slot requirements, or ambiguous intents at ANY step (not only Step 1). Never guess business logic when a brief question removes ambiguity.
